title: Umurinzi w'umuriro utazima
intro: Umuntu ahagaze ku muryango w’ahantu hateye ubwoba cyane mu bitagaragara, yahawe inshingano idafite ikindi kiremwa cyifuza. Iyo imitima ibabaye itaka imbabazi, igisubizo gikomeye cyumvikana mu byumba by’umuriro. Ese ushobora kumenya uwo murinzi w’iteka ryose?
clues: Mpagaze ku muryango w'ahantu hateye ubwoba ho guhanwa mu bitagaragara.
Umuriro ugurumana kandi utazima ni wo mushinga w'inshingano zanjye zikomeye.
Abantu bababaye bahamagara izina ryanjye, bansaba koroherwa no kubabazwa kwabo guhoraho.
Iyo basabye imbabazi, ndababwira ko batazigera bavayo.
Sindi umuntu, kandi sindi jini — ndi ikiremwa cyaremwe gifite ubudahemuka busesuye.
Ndi umumarayika mukuru washyizweho nk'umurinzi w'iteka ry'umuriro wa Gehinomu.

arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
verse: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain." (43:77)
